description: Main recruitable cast, Gen-1 androids (9) + Sere candidate. Chassis-hard per the craft lesson; each carries a varied stamped decommission brand (their failing-empathy death-certificate worn on the chassis). Looks from the rustline-hesperia reconciliation faction-look cues. Sere = a HELD-FOR-MIKE candidate.
